title: Lock lifecycle: contention retry, single source of truth, decidable staleness
description: Audited session: sync refresh failed on search-index lock contention, doctor reported lock.search_index.active while lock inspect said none, and the agent slept 65s to outwait the stale window. sync refresh retries briefly on lock contention; doctor and lock inspect read the same lock state; lock owners carry PID plus heartbeat so staleness is decidable without waiting.
acceptanceCriteria: sync refresh retries on search-index lock contention instead of returning ok:false
doctor and lock inspect report identical lock state in tests
Stale-lock detection uses owner PID/heartbeat, no fixed wait window required
closedReason: Acceptance criteria met; commit checkpoint recorded as dirty-path evidence because unrelated pre-existing staged and dirty changes prevent a scoped commit.
